notes: Gold Stays campaign v2 — Kelly psyche-as-architecture on 4K necklace boudoir. Signed Iris Productions. Operator approved 2026-07-08.

posts.caption:
Gold stays.

Same getting-ready boudoir. Same cream silk. Same coin pendant on my neck.

Then the room starts rearranging — mirror shifts, silk drifts, vanity props slide — like the set forgot I was the campaign.

Light crushes. The gold glints anyway.

Quiet luxury isn't quiet because nothing moves.
